title: Another solvable population dynamic with uniform ancestral memory
summary: We study a population model with non-overlapping generations, where individuals have a type and retain the memory of the types of all their ancestors. We assume that for each individual, the reproduction law depends on the empirical distribution of ancestral types, unlike for a classical multi-type branching process where it hinges on the parental type only. We further assume the mean reproduction matrix has rank one.
